item.title: FBI psychiatrist returns as Lindsay Clancy murder trial nears closing arguments
item.summary: Defendant Lindsay Clancy wipes away tears as she listens to testimony during the Lindsay Clancy murder trial in Plymouth Superior Court, Plymouth, Mass., on Tuesday, Aug. 25, 2026. (Greg Derr/The Patriot Ledger via AP, Pool) 2026-08-26T13:58:06Z The prosecution resumed questioning its final witness Wednesday in the murder trial against Lindsay Clancy , with an FBI psychiatrist returning to the stand before the defense questions him and closing arguments begin. Dr. Gregory Saathoff, a forensic psychiatrist at the University of Virginia and a senior psychiatrist for the FBI’s Behavioral Analysis Unit, began testifying Tuesday that he did not believe Clancy’s account that a voice ordered her to kill her three young children. ___ EDITOR’S NOTE: This story includes discussion of suicide. If you or someone you know needs help, the national suicide and crisis lifeline in the U.S. is available by calling or texting 988. ___ Clancy’s mental health is a key issue at her trial.
